$comment: Release gate for the built manifest. Any change to what the extension may access must be made here deliberately, in a reviewed commit, and justified in store/listing.md. Adding a permission can make Chrome disable the extension for existing users until they re-approve it, and triggers extra Web Store review.

accounts.$comment: Present only when the build has backend settings (the WXT_SUPABASE_* repository variables). Then both must appear, exactly.
